synopsis:
The hardest part of moving on is starting over.

After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate, Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK's remaining members struggle to find a path forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective brought by two new band members, spark a renewed creative energy that sets them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention.

Following the band from intimate studio sessions in 2022 through the release of their FROM ZERO album and their explosive concert in São Paulo, UNSHATTER weaves together rare archival footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans. The film captures the raw, honest story of what it means to begin again.

synopsis:
On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury. 

Now, this original concert film has been beautifully rescanned and remastered in 4K alongside a dynamic new audio mix, featuring many of Queen's favourite tracks— "Bohemian Rhapsody,” "Crazy Little Thing Called Love," "I Want To Break Free” and "We Are The Champions." With three years to go before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this was the first Western rock concert performed in a stadium behind the then Iron Curtain. It was of such significance to the Hungarian authorities and film industry that a group of the country’s top film cameramen and technicians were brought together to film it for posterity.
